objective: Train a consolidated V2-4 candidate using frozen Baseline V2-2 features plus the selected E6.1 velocity feature subset.
decision_rule: If E6.1 improves PR-AUC or Lift@5 versus V2-2, mark as candidate for production merge. Prefer the smallest feature set with stable TopK improvement.
note: V2-4 is a consolidated experiment. It does not modify existing V2-2 features, labels, temporal split, preprocessing outputs, or model architecture.
